exposure: timing of elective repeat cesarean delivery (ERCD)
cohort: Singleton deliveries born by repeat cesarean from the US Natality Database (2004-2008), excluding those with a trial of labor, fetal anomalies, or history of diabetes/hypertension related disorders.
finding: Hispanic Whites delivered by ERCD showed no increased prematurity risk at 38 weeks, unlike non-Hispanic Whites who had lower prematurity risk at 39 weeks.
mod_finding: Hispanic Whites delivered by ERCD showed no increased prematurity risk at 38 weeks, unlike non-Hispanic Whites who had lower prematurity risk at 39 weeks.
